project.name: BerkahEmas
project.context: Ready-to-use gold-store software. ERP source is jewerly-erp; marketing site is astaenterprise. BerkahBekhan produces the sales content.

run.command: Use an isolated SQLite database with fictional fixtures; run the existing Laravel app and its production asset build.
run.notes: This session used task-local SQLite under D:/Repos/.berkahemas-work/. Credentials and session state stay outside content artifacts. PHP extensions pdo_sqlite, sqlite3, gd, sockets and zip were enabled per process. Locked spreadsheet dependency has a pre-existing PHP upper-bound conflict; Composer installed with --ignore-platform-req=php+ for this local check.

features.name: Inventori, pencarian dan filter
features.clientValue: Staf dapat mencari stok menurut nama, kategori, dan kadar.

features.name: POS sampai nota
features.clientValue: Kasir dapat memilih produk, menyimpan penjualan, dan melihat nota dengan identitas toko.

features.name: Pencatatan buyback
features.clientValue: Staf dapat memilih pelanggan, mencatat perhiasan, kadar dan berat, lalu melihat catatan tersimpan.

features.name: Laporan operasional
features.clientValue: Pemilik dapat membuka ringkasan laporan dengan pilihan periode.

evidence.note: Screen rendered in the isolated runtime; filter calculations were not independently revalidated.

demoFlows.name: inventory-search-filter
demoFlows.expectedResult: Search Cincin and category CC / 18K purity filters show matching real rows.
demoFlows.notes: Verified only against the isolated fictional demo, not production.

demoFlows.name: pos-to-invoice
demoFlows.expectedResult: Product selection, non-zero total, successful saved transaction and visible merchant invoice. Merchant name and custom invoice header preserved.
demoFlows.notes: Verified only against the isolated fictional demo, not production.

demoFlows.name: buyback-create
demoFlows.expectedResult: Jewelry details, purity, weight and non-zero estimate submitted; saved item remains in buyback history after a fresh visit.
demoFlows.notes: Verified only against the isolated fictional demo, not production.

forbiddenOnScreen: Passwords, session cookies or access tokens
privacy.demoDataNotes: Products, staff and customer names are fictional; contacts use .test domains. Merchant is Toko Emas Demo. Stock and transaction numbers describe only this isolated fixture dataset.

forbiddenClaims: 200+ stores or any unverified customer count
Guaranteed revenue improvement or time savings
Free service, scarcity, or delivery-time promises
limitations: Production readiness and deployment were not verified.
Report rendering was observed; accounting/report calculations were not independently audited.
Existing recording CLI cannot load authenticated storage state.
Compositor currently adds static hook/CTA around a uniformly scaled full capture; it does not implement planned cuts, timed overlays, or focus zooms.
Three silent captioned demo MP4 drafts were produced from real isolated-demo recordings; publication and optional audio remain pending.
